data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'izz', meaning 'pride' or 'honor'. Izzati is a name that evokes a sense of self-worth and dignity, reminding us of the importance of maintaining our dignity and respecting the dignity of others in Islam. The name Izzati carries the meaning “Pride, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izzati usually hope their child will grow to embody pride, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
